name: Linear regulator (LDO)
description: Behavioural linear voltage regulator in the LM1117 style; the OUT pin is a supply for the nets it feeds.

rth_ja.doc: Thermal resistance, junction to ambient; 0: no thermal model (with tsd: thermal limiting on)

tsd.doc: The temperature its thermal shutdown holds the die at; 0: none

cth_j.doc: Heat capacity of the die (not published: an estimate)

cth_s.doc: Heat capacity of the package and its pad (not published: an estimate)

functional.claims: OUT drives (1, supply); IN and GND are ignored.

timed.claims: As functional on digital nets, as electrical on analog nets.

electrical.claims: vout while vin > vout + dropout, otherwise tracks vin - dropout; current limited to imax; quiescent current into GND (SPEC-004 §7 regulator). With rth_ja and tsd (the NCP1117ST50 preset, from onsemi's NCP1117/D: SOT-223 160 K/W minimum pad, 15 K/W junction to case, the die held at about 175 C), its die heats with its own dissipation and thermal shutdown takes its current limit to nothing over 2 K above tsd, so an overloaded regulator without a heatsink sags and holds its die near 175 C.
omissions: thermal limiting's exact control law (not published: a 2 K band above tsd) and the heat capacities (estimates)

sources.title: LM1117 800-mA Low-Dropout Linear Regulator datasheet (Texas Instruments)
AMS1117 1A Low Dropout Voltage Regulator datasheet (Advanced Monolithic Systems)
LD1117 low drop positive voltage regulator datasheet (STMicroelectronics): 1 V dropout at 800 mA, 5 mA quiescent
LD39050 500 mA low quiescent current low noise voltage regulator datasheet (STMicroelectronics): 200 mV dropout at 500 mA, 20 uA quiescent
SGM2212 800mA, low noise, low quiescent current, high PSRR, low dropout linear regulator datasheet (SG Micro), Rev. A.2: 390 mV dropout at 800 mA, 1.1 A current limit, 80 uA ground current (typical)

onsemi NCP1117/D: 1.0 A low-dropout positive fixed and adjustable voltage regulators: SOT-223 thermal resistance junction-to-ambient 160 C/W (minimum pad), junction-to-case 15 C/W; junction temperature -55 to 150 C; internal thermal shutdown limits the die to approximately 175 C; dropout 1.07 V typical at 800 mA; current limit 1.5 A typical; quiescent current 6.0 mA typical (5.0 V)

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.doc: The room's temperature (the world's while not set)

outputs.name: thermal_limit
outputs.doc: Its thermal shutdown is limiting the output

fr.description: Régulateur de tension linéaire comportemental style LM1117 ; la broche OUT est une alimentation pour les réseaux qu'elle dessert.

functional.claims: OUT impose (1, alimentation) ; IN et GND sont ignorées.

timed.claims: Comme en fonctionnel sur les réseaux numériques, comme en électrique sur les réseaux analogiques.

electrical.claims: vout tant que vin > vout + dropout, sinon suit vin - dropout ; courant limité à imax ; courant de repos vers GND (SPEC-004 §7 regulator). Avec rth_ja et tsd (le préréglage NCP1117ST50, tiré du NCP1117/D d'onsemi : SOT-223 160 K/W avec pastille minimale, 15 K/W de la jonction au boîtier, la puce maintenue vers 175 C), sa puce chauffe avec sa propre dissipation et la protection thermique ramène sa limite de courant à zéro sur 2 K au-dessus de tsd, de sorte qu'un régulateur surchargé sans dissipateur s'affaisse et maintient sa puce vers 175 C.
omissions: la régulation de charge et de ligne
la stabilité selon le condensateur de sortie
la loi de commande exacte de la limitation thermique (non publiée : une bande de 2 K au-dessus de tsd) et les capacités thermiques (estimations)
